name: email-template-tester
description: Turn Figma email designs into tested Klaviyo templates: Figma → MJML → pre-checks → Klaviyo [TEST] template → Litmus review and fixes → handoff to the client's Klaviyo with the client's own image links. One folder per brand or client.

klaviyo_api_key.title: Klaviyo private API key
klaviyo_api_key.description: A private key with Images: Full access and Templates: Full access, everything else No access. Leave empty if every project uses its own per-brand key.

litmus_test_address.title: Litmus test address
litmus_test_address.description: Your personal Litmus address (...@litmusemail.com). Test emails can only be sent to this address. Separate several with commas.
